answer: Duplicate identities cost attackers a full deposit per key, so mass registration becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn stake: each agent must burn a ferrous token deposit to register, and the protocol's kernel records the burn permanently. Over a long horizon, honest agents recover value through attested work rewards while attackers only accumulate losses, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
